endpoint.description: Agent JSON-RPC endpoint URL the invocation was sent to.

card_url.description: Agent Card URL fetched at preflight.

card_sha256.description: Canonical digest of the fetched Agent Card. Pinned per stage; a stage-configured pre-pin mismatch halts.

protocol_version.description: Negotiated A2A protocol version (the JSONRPC interface's protocolVersion).

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the upstream response was observed.

invocation_id.description: UUIDv7 identifying this single wire invocation.

context_id.description: A2A context id grouping the stage's task with its messages.

task_state.description: Task state carried by the upstream response (absent for card_discovery).

upstream.description: The raw upstream A2A response object (Agent Card, SendMessageResponse or Task). Typed-validated by the adapter's wire model before wrapping; core never re-interprets it.

upstream_sha256.description: Canonical digest of the upstream object, binding this receipt to the observed bytes.

then.description: A card_discovery receipt must not claim a task the operation never saw.
